svg.title: Monitoring Supplement — Grassland Carbon Workshop
svg.desc: Illustration of a Canadian grassland — bunchgrass tussocks, forbs, sagebrush and scattered open-grown oaks above a deep soil profile threaded with roots, each root system descending from a plant above it — headed "Monitoring Supplement".
svg.text: DETECTING CHANGE • EQUIVALENT SOIL MASS • SOIL HEALTH INDICATORS
